usage_requirements: Cross-encoder sequence-pair classifier: input is a (premise, hypothesis) pair, output is 3 logits with label order id 0=contradiction, 1=entailment, 2=neutral (per config.json id2label)
Load via sentence_transformers.CrossEncoder('cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-base') or transformers AutoModelForSequenceClassification; no trust_remote_code needed
No query:/passage: text prefixes; no pooling choice (classification head, not an embedding model)
Tokenizer is a DeBERTa-v2 SentencePiece tokenizer: the `sentencepiece` package must be installed or tokenizer instantiation fails
config.json model_type is 'deberta-v2' (DebertaV2ForSequenceClassification) despite the v3 name; max_position_embeddings=512 with relative position buckets
Usable for zero-shot classification via the transformers zero-shot-classification pipeline (entailment label present)
known_issues: DeBERTa-v3 tokenizer loading has a history of failures ('This tokenizer cannot be instantiated. Please make sure you have sentencepiece installed') where installing sentencepiece alone was not always sufficient on older transformers versions (huggingface/transformers#14470)
Repo maintainer re-pushed the tokenizer files in April 2025 ('Push tokenizer again' commit), indicating past tokenizer-file problems; use a recent snapshot of the repo
unknowns: embedding_dim (not applicable: classification cross-encoder, no sentence embedding output)
MNLI matched-set accuracy (model card reports only the mismatched set)
exact effective max_seq_length used at fine-tuning time (512 is the config max_position_embeddings; card does not state a training truncation length)
